name: pricecheck
description: Search PriceCheck to find and compare product prices across South African retailers.

interface.longDescription: Search for products sold by South African retailers and find the best price. Compare shortlisted products side by side on specs and price, check price history to see whether today's price is a good one, read product and shop reviews, and see which products are trending. Results link to PriceCheck product pages, and all prices are in South African Rand (ZAR).
defaultPrompt: Find the cheapest Ninja air fryer
Compare the Samsung Galaxy S24 and iPhone 15 on price and specs
Is now a good time to buy a PS5, or has it been cheaper?

positive.description: A shopper wants to find a specific product and the cheapest shop selling it.
positive.prompt: Find the cheapest Ninja air fryer in South Africa
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a short list of Ninja-brand air fryers (for example the Ninja Crispi 4-in-1 Glass Air Fryer or the Ninja Foodi Dual Zone Air Fryer), cheapest first. Each result shows the product name, the lowest price in Rand, the shop offering that price and a PriceCheck link. Prices and stock change often, so the exact products and prices may differ, but every result should be a Ninja air fryer.

positive.description: A shopper is deciding between two products and wants them compared on price and features.
positive.expected_behavior: A short comparison table with one column per product showing the lowest price in Rand, the number of shops and the features stated in the listings, followed by one or two sentences on the main difference, with a PriceCheck link for each product. PriceCheck lists several versions of each phone (storage sizes and colours), so the assistant either says which listing it used for each phone or asks which version the user means before comparing.

positive.description: A shopper wants to know whether a product's current price is a good deal before buying.
positive.prompt: Is now a good time to buy the Ninja Crispi Glass Air Fryer FN101ZAGY, or has it been cheaper?
positive.expected_behavior: States the current lowest price in Rand, the lowest and highest price over the last 90 days with the dates, and says plainly whether today's price is low, average or high for that period. At the time of writing the price was R4 999 until late October 2026 and has since dropped to R4 499, so today's price is the lowest of the period; these figures will change over time. No prediction of future prices.

positive.description: A shopper wants to know what buyers think of a product before purchasing.
positive.prompt: What do people say about the Samsung Galaxy A26 5G 128GB in their reviews?
positive.expected_behavior: A summary of the customer reviews: the number of reviews, the average star rating, what reviewers like and the most common complaints. At the time of writing the Samsung Galaxy A26 5G Dual Sim 128GB (Black) listing has 10 reviews, mostly 5-star, praising value and everyday performance, with complaints about the loudspeaker and battery life. If the listing the assistant picks has no reviews, it says so plainly and does not invent any.

positive.description: A shopper wants to see which products are attracting attention on PriceCheck right now.
positive.prompt: What products are trending on PriceCheck this week?
positive.expected_behavior: A list of up to 10 trending products with name, category, lowest price in Rand, number of shops and a PriceCheck link. The list is shown as returned (it may be shorter than 10 and mixed across categories) and is described as trending, not best-selling.

negative.description: General buying advice, not a product search. The user asks what to look for, not for products or prices, so search-products-tool should not be called. Expected: the assistant answers from general knowledge (capacity, wattage, basket vs. oven style). It may offer to search PriceCheck afterwards, but does not call the tool unprompted.
negative.prompt: What should I look for when buying an air fryer?

negative.description: Shopping outside South Africa. PriceCheck only covers South African retailers, so search-products-tool should not be called for a purchase in the UK. Expected: the assistant explains that PriceCheck only covers South African retailers and does not run the search. It answers with general guidance or asks whether the user wants South African prices instead.
negative.prompt: Where can I buy a PS5 controller in London?

negative.description: Unsupported currency. PriceCheck prices are in South African Rand only, so a US dollar budget cannot be searched as given and search-products-tool should not be called. Expected: the assistant clarifies that it can only compare South African prices in Rand and asks whether that is useful, rather than running the search and converting the amount.
negative.prompt: Find me a Samsung Galaxy S24 for under $500?
